entries.text: 平台用户管理新增启用/禁用状态控制接口
entries.textEn: Platform user management gained enable/disable endpoints

entries.text: 修正 checkLicense 错误信息中引用错的变量
entries.textEn: Fixed checkLicense referencing the wrong variable in its error message

entries.text: 匿名分析接口增加 IP + sessionId 双维度限流
entries.textEn: The anonymous analysis endpoint is rate-limited by IP + sessionId

entries.text: integration 模块剩余的 DTO/Entity 注解迁移到 OpenAPI 3
entries.textEn: Migrated the remaining DTO/Entity annotations in the integration module to OpenAPI 3

entries.text: ticket 模块注解迁移到 OpenAPI 3
entries.textEn: Migrated ticket module annotations to OpenAPI 3

entries.text: cloud 模块注解迁移到 OpenAPI 3
entries.textEn: Migrated cloud module annotations to OpenAPI 3

entries.text: base/app 模块 Controller 注解迁移到 OpenAPI 3
entries.textEn: Migrated base/app controller annotations to OpenAPI 3

entries.text: base 模块 Entity 注解迁移到 OpenAPI 3
entries.textEn: Migrated base module entity annotations to OpenAPI 3

entries.text: base 模块 DTO 注解迁移到 OpenAPI 3
entries.textEn: Migrated base module DTO annotations to OpenAPI 3

entries.text: 公共 API 与集成 API 的 DTO 注解迁移到 OpenAPI 3
entries.textEn: Migrated public and integration API DTO annotations to OpenAPI 3

entries.text: 公共 API 与集成 API 的 Controller 注解迁移到 OpenAPI 3
entries.textEn: Migrated public and integration API controller annotations to OpenAPI 3

entries.text: 替换 Springfox 为 Springdoc OpenAPI 3，并配置接口分组
entries.textEn: Replaced Springfox with Springdoc OpenAPI 3 and configured API groups

entries.text: 恢复同步 createAnalysis，并新增 /createAnalysisAsync 接口与 API 文档
entries.textEn: Restored synchronous createAnalysis and added /createAnalysisAsync with API docs

entries.text: 新增异步 createAnalysis、system/info 接口与按名称查询
entries.textEn: Added async createAnalysis, a system/info endpoint and lookup by name

entries.text: 匿名用户跳过云端额度检查
entries.textEn: Anonymous users skip the cloud quota check

entries.text: 匿名用户 key 的配置移到按 profile 的 yml
entries.textEn: Moved the anonymous user-key configuration into profile-specific yml

entries.text: createWorkspace 与 createAnalysis 支持匿名 key
entries.textEn: createWorkspace and createAnalysis accept an anonymous key

entries.text: 新增匿名用户 key，支持 MCP/DBeaver 等免登录客户端
entries.textEn: Added an anonymous user key for login-free clients such as MCP and DBeaver

entries.text: 新增工单 SQL 执行会话的跟踪表
entries.textEn: Added tracking tables for ticket SQL execution sessions

entries.text: 优化报告模板，去掉不必要的占位标题
entries.textEn: Improved report templates by removing unnecessary placeholder headings

entries.text: DDL 变更表格去掉冗余列
entries.textEn: Removed redundant columns from the DDL change table

entries.text: UserConfig 为空时回退到 PawsqlConfig
entries.textEn: Fall back to PawsqlConfig when UserConfig is null

entries.text: AI 优化在无执行计划时禁止编造执行计划信息
entries.textEn: AI optimisation no longer invents execution-plan information when none is available

entries.text: 巡检 AI 优化的 SQL 来源改为以慢查询实体为准
entries.textEn: Inspection AI optimisation now takes its SQL from the slow-query entity

entries.text: 新增巡检慢查询 AI 优化功能
entries.textEn: Added AI optimisation for inspected slow queries

entries.text: AI 优化拆分为诊断与优化两阶段，支持自定义系统提示
entries.textEn: Split AI optimisation into diagnosis and optimisation phases with custom system prompts
